objective: Coordinator's go-ahead (19 November 2026): every ring result from RING-FORMULA to SCALE-SHARE sits under parity. Under the nearest non-parity law with machinery in the repo (not-all-equal), define the cheapest growth (the same joining policy, the fewest counts, a junction implied when the existing constraints already force it) and grow the ring of five five-place knots, a spare-less ring, a chain, two touching knots, a lone knot and a two-ring join: does a ring still feed itself at a fixed ratio, the same root or another, does the cluster picture survive, and is bond distance enough to say who joins whom. Stop at a yes with a ratio, a no with the reason, or a law with no well-defined cheapest growth. Serves G17.
stop_rule: One pilot (fitting), one frozen run, read-out, referee hand-off, report.
title: Do loops keep branching under the not-all-equal law?
